about: DRAFT, never run. JetBrains Mellum2.1-12B-A2.5B-Thinking (mellum: 28 layers, 64 experts top-8, 2.5B active, 1,024-token sliding window on 3 of every 4 layers) at Q8_0 (KLD 0.008 vs BF16 per JetBrains) from JetBrains' GGUF repository, text only, on the RTX Spark N1X's GPU at its native 131,072 tokens. Upstream llama.cpp b11718 (mellum in llama-arch.cpp, with #30578/#30584 fixes; #30612 adds Mellum MTP, but this GGUF carries no MTP layer, so no draft). JetBrains' sampling (temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 20); it thinks in <think> blocks, so --reasoning-format deepseek. Only the 7 global layers keep full KV (4 heads x 128): 131,072 tokens is 1.75 GiB f16.
setup: One RTX Spark N1X. 12.9 GB of downloads (one Q8_0 GGUF). Expected resident memory ~15 GiB at 131,072 tokens (12.0 GiB weights, 1.75 GiB f16 KV plus the sliding-window cache, compute buffers).
